name: TreeviewControl
description: Represents the hierarchical member-selection control of a cube field.
remarks: Use this object primarily for macro recording; it is not intended for any other use.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the hidden status of the cube field members in the hierarchical member-selection control of a cube field.

properties.name: Drilled
properties.description: Sets the "drilled" (expanded or visible) status of the cube field members in the hierarchical member-selection control of a cube field. This property is used primarily for macro recording and isn't intended for any other use. Read/write.
